messages.subject: Janice | Energy & Natural Resources Executive | ESG, Government Relations and Africa Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Janice,

Your leadership of Kestria South Africa and your firm's Energy, Natural Resources & Infrastructure coverage make this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where resource-sector performance depends on ESG, government relations and disciplined stakeholder execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around large-scale solar and battery storage and carbon-data readiness, giving me direct exposure to responsible industrial transition in a regulated operating environment.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Government Affairs, External Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Social Performance, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership in mining, energy and infrastructure businesses. I am internationally mobile and open to South Africa, wider Africa, the Middle East and other global assignments.

I have attached a Kestria South Africa-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for suitable current or upcoming searches.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
